title: Tried 3 of them and none were waterproof.
text: Tried 3 of them and none were waterproof.. I tried 3 of these as first 2 were not waterproof.  I gave benefit of the doubt and the replacement is not waterproof either. Thank goodness I have matress case on but now I have to wash it. This product is NOT waterproof. Its soft but that's the only benefit.  I will be requesting my money back and sending these back.
